title: Digital Automatic Karl Fischer Titrator | Moisture Determination Instrument For Liquids & Powders | 10 Ml Auto Zero Burette | Dual Platinum Electrode | Built-In Magnetic Stirrer |
description: The Spector Litt Digital Automatic Karl Fischer Titrator is a precision laboratory instrument designed for accurate moisture determination in liquids and powders using the Karl Fischer titration method. Equipped with a 10 Ml Auto Zero Glass Burette, Dual Platinum Electrodes, and a built-in variable speed magnetic stirrer, it ensures reliable endpoint detection and highly repeatable results. The user-friendly digital control panel allows simple operation, making it ideal for pharmaceutical, chemical, petrochemical, food, and research laboratories.
